newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT IN ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT IN ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Zimbabwe skipper Alistair Campbell won the toss and elected to bat in his side's one-day match against India on Monday.
India - Saurav Ganguly, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Salil Ankola, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad.
Zimbabwe - Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Alistair Campbell, Paul Strang, Andy Flower (captain), David Houghton, Guy Whittal, Craig Evans, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
